SOURCE & CONTEXT

About this prototype

All 24 events are fictional interface fixtures. They do not describe real attacks and must not be used for analysis.

When GTD is connected

We will identify the selected release and coverage. GTD fatalities and injuries include attackers. Unknown values will remain distinct from zero, and totals will include known values only.

The main GTD database has a gap for 1993. Coordinates can represent settlement centroids, not precise attack sites. Classification follows GTD, and differences in collection methods affect comparisons over time.

Records without coordinates remain in summaries and the event list. Map movement does not change the filters or totals. Numbered markers group events; their numbers are event counts, not fatalities.

Raw GTD data is not distributed here. Publication of real records requires checking the applicable terms.
